sources.name: planetsig/ufo-reports — NUFORC scrubbed, geocoded, time-standardized CSV
sources.note: Community-scraped mirror of the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC) public sighting archive, geocoded (opengeocode.org / MaxMind worldcities / findlatitudelongitude.com) and time-standardized by GitHub user planetsig (Sigmond Axel), consolidated 2014-06-30. 80,332 rows verified by SHA-256 against the repo's own csv-data/sha256cksums.txt at retrieval time.
